concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: Central topic of the torah — during prayer one must nullify awareness of others and ultimately of oneself.
The Abba Shaul passage (cited as siman 55) describes a deeper level of bittul during prayer where one does not even sense one's own existence.
During prayer, one stands in the King's Palace — at that point 'who is he? his selfhood is nullified, there is nothing here but the King Himself.' This could form a bechina with bittul.
HaShem Yitbarach alone remains when selfhood is nullified in prayer.
